comment: Every resolved value that the server of an engine may have different from the CLI of the same engine for one request, with the reason serving requires it. tools/serve_cli_parity.py config fails on any difference that is not listed here. A row may pin cli / serve values: it then stops applying when either side changes.

*.reason: names the entry point itself (cli / http-single / http-batch)

glm.reason: serving-only state (slots, batch scheduler, import route, wire): no CLI counterpart
serving-only lever: chunking applies only while another request decodes

minimax.reason: serving-only state (scheduler and DSpark policy): no CLI counterpart
request slots exist only in the server
a request must fail within a minute when the peer is gone; the CLI waits out an uneven two-rank load

qualified with a single engine owner; not qualified with several sessions sharing the engine (open: qualify it for serving)
